column1: FREE SOURCES ALREADY IN USE (keep using - no need to pay):
- JPC (jpcsteel.co.in) - free monthly bulletin PDFs, billet/pig iron/sponge iron, official Ministry of Steel body.
- EEPC (metal.eepcindia.org/view-export/[N]) - free monthly Metal Price Monitor, real Indian billet prices. Use COMPARISON table only, "Average Prices" table is stale/buggy.
- LME.com - free live spot for Steel Scrap CFR India (Platts), Turkey, China HRC. Historical is PAID.
- Ayron Mart free page (ayronmart.com/semi-finished-steel-prices) - todays ingot/billet with direction, no login.
- exchangerates.org.uk - full daily USD/INR history by year, free.
- BigMint free articles - occasionally state real Alang HMS numbers in text (searchable, good for spot-checks).
- RBI / PIB / DGTR - repo rate, policy, duty notifications, all free.
ACCESS TRICKS THAT WORK (found during this project):

- TRADINGVIEW BLANK CHART: if the chart canvas renders blank in automation, click camera icon -> "Download image". This forces a real canvas re-render that can then be read. Worked for SC1!, HC1!, BDI, TIO1!, ACF1!.
- TRADINGVIEW SYMBOL SEARCH: search by PRODUCT NAME not ticker (e.g. "steel HRC" finds HC, "coking coal" finds ACF). Tickers often fail.
- EEPC ARCHIVE: sequential URL pattern /view-export/[N] - 32=Sep2025, 31=Aug2025, 30=Jul2025. Decrement N to go back in time.
- EXCHANGERATES.ORG.UK: one page per year gives full daily history free, no login.
- LME: individual metal pages show todays spot free even though the historical archive is paid.
- GENERAL: sites that block automated fetch (robots.txt) often still allow a logged-in human browser session - Barchart and BigMint both block automation but work manually.
RECOMMENDATION: Buy TradingView Plus + Ayron Mart first (total ~Rs 26,300/yr). Together they fix the daily-data
problem AND test the ingot hypothesis. Only consider BigMint after seeing whether those two produce a validated edge.

HONEST VERDICT: subscription is NOT necessary and does NOT guarantee an edge. Real daily USD/INR (free,
zero leakage) was tested rigorously and showed NO edge at most horizons - proof that clean data alone
does not create a signal that is not there. A subscription only removes the "we could not test it" excuse.
